messages.content: 'ma bhat khanchhu' lai negative ma kasari bhanne?
negative ma 'ma bhat khanna' hunchha. 'khanchhu' ko negative 'khanna' ho, 'khandina' pani bhanna milchha.
ma school janchhu ko ulto (negative) k hunchha?
'ma school jaanna' ki 'ma school jaadina'. duitai thik chhan, bolchal ma 'jaadina' badhi sunchha.
chha ko negative k ho? ani ho ko?
'chha' ko negative 'chhaina' ho, jastai 'ghar ma pani chha' bata 'ghar ma pani chhaina'. 'ho' ko negative 'haina' ho, jastai 'yo mero kitab ho' bata 'yo mero kitab haina'.
yo mero ghar ho, negative banaidinus na
'yo mero ghar haina.' 'ho' lai 'haina' le badalnu parchha.
u ramro gaunchha -> negative?
'u ramro gaudaina.' teshro purush ma 'gaunchha' ko negative 'gaudaina' hunchha.
timi aaja aayau, negative ma k hunchha? past tense ho ni yo
ho, past tense ho. negative ma 'timi aaja aayenau' hunchha. bhut kaal ma aghi 'na-' ra pachhi '-enau' jasto rup aauchha: aayau -> aayenau.
tapai chiya khanuhunchha? lai negative statement banaunus
'tapai chiya khanuhunna.' aadar garne rup ma 'khanuhunchha' ko negative 'khanuhunna' hunchha.
garchhu, gare, garnechhu yo teen ta kun kun tense ho?

'garchhu' vartaman (present) ho: ma ahile ki sadhai garchhu. 'gare' bhut (past) ho: maile garisake. 'garnechhu' bhabishya (future) ho: ma pachhi garchhu bhanne. jastai: ma kaam garchhu, maile kaam gare, ma bholi kaam garnechhu.
'ma padhchhu' lai past ra future ma lekhnu na
past: 'maile padhe.' future: 'ma padhnechhu' (ki bolchal ma 'ma padhchhu hola' / 'padhla'). past ma karta ma '-le' thapinchha, tyasaile 'ma' -> 'maile'.
hijo ma bajar jaanchhu. yo sentence ma k galti chha?
'hijo' le past janauchha, tara 'jaanchhu' present ho. thik vakya: 'hijo ma bajar gaye.' 'jaanu' ko past 'gaye' hunchha.
bholi maile khana khaye. thik chha?
thik chhaina. 'bholi' future ho tara 'khaye' past ho. thik: 'bholi ma khana khanechhu.' future ma 'maile' haina, 'ma' aauchha.
nepali ma plural kasari banaune? jastai keta ko

dherai jasto shabda pachhi '-haru' thapera plural banchha: keta -> ketaharu, kitab -> kitabharu, sathi -> sathiharu. tara sankhya bhaye pachhi prayah '-haru' chahindaina: 'teen jana keta' bhanda pugchha.
'5 wata kitabharu' bhanna milchha?
bolchal ma sunchha, tara ramro nepali ma '5 wata kitab' bhannu thik ho. sankhya le nai dherai janaisakeko hunchha, tyasaile '-haru' doharo hunchha.
chara, rukh, bidyarthi ko plural bhannus
chara -> charaharu, rukh -> rukhharu, bidyarthi -> bidyarthiharu. sabai ma '-haru' matra thapne ho.
ta, timi, tapai, hajur ma farak k ho?

yo aadar ko star ho. 'ta' ekdam najik ko manchhe ki sano bachha lai (ki risaema) bhaninchha. 'timi' sathi ra barabari ko lagi. 'tapai' thula ra anjan manchhe lai aadar ko lagi. 'hajur' sabai bhanda badhi aadar, jastai hajurbuba-hajuraama lai. kriya pani badalinchha: ta gars, timi gara, tapai garnus, hajur garibaksiyos.
'basa' lai tapai ra ta form ma bhannus
ta form: 'bas.' timi form: 'basa.' tapai form: 'basnus.' ekdam aadar: 'basibaksiyos.'
aama lai 'khana khau' bhannu thik ho?
dherai pariwar ma aama lai 'timi' bhanchhan, tyasaile 'khana khau' chalchha. tara aadar dekhauna 'khana khanus' bhannu ramro ho. pariwar anusar farak parchha.
boss lai 'yo file hera' bhane, thik hunchha?
office ma boss lai 'hera' alik anaadar lagchha. 'yo file hernus' ki 'yo file herdinus' bhannus. 'herdinus' ma anurodh ko bhaw pani aauchha.
'tapai kaha jaanchhau?' ma k galti chha?
'tapai' sanga 'jaanchhau' milena. 'jaanchhau' timi ko rup ho. thik: 'tapai kaha jaanuhunchha?' ki timi bhanne bhaye 'timi kaha jaanchhau?'
english ma child ko plural k ho? childs?
haina, 'childs' galat ho. 'child' ko plural 'children' ho. yo irregular plural ho, '-s' thapdaina.
plural of mouse, tooth, foot, man?
mouse -> mice, tooth -> teeth, foot -> feet, man -> men. These are irregular plurals, so you just have to remember them.
box ko plural boxs ho ki boxes?
'boxes' ho. jun shabda s, x, z, ch, sh ma sakinchha, tyasma '-es' thapinchha: box -> boxes, bus -> buses, watch -> watches.
baby ko plural babys?
haina, 'babies'. consonant pachhi '-y' aaye 'y' hatayera '-ies' thapne: baby -> babies, city -> cities. tara vowel pachhi y bhaye '-s' matra: boy -> boys.
sheep ko plural sheeps ho?
haina, 'sheep' ko plural pani 'sheep' nai ho. 'one sheep, ten sheep.' fish ra deer pani yastai hun.
go ko past tense goed ho?
haina, 'go' ko past 'went' ho. 'goed' bhanne shabda chhaina. jastai: 'I went to school yesterday.'
past tense bhana: eat, write, buy, play, run
eat -> ate, write -> wrote, buy -> bought, play -> played, run -> ran. 'play' matra regular ho ('-ed' thapne), baki sabai irregular hun.
what is the past tense of 'teach' and 'catch'?
'teach' becomes 'taught' and 'catch' becomes 'caught'. Both are irregular, so no '-ed'.
'She go to school every day.' yo thik ho?
thik chhaina. 'she' (he/she/it) sanga present ma verb ma '-es' thapinchha: 'She goes to school every day.'
fix this: 'I has two brother.'
Correct: 'I have two brothers.' 'I' takes 'have', not 'has', and 'two' needs the plural 'brothers'.
'Yesterday I eat momo.' sudhar garidinus
'Yesterday I ate momo.' 'yesterday' le past janauchha, tyasaile 'eat' ko past 'ate' chahinchha.
'They was playing football' ma galti k ho?
'they' sanga 'was' haina, 'were' aauchha. thik: 'They were playing football.' was chai I/he/she/it sanga.
'He don't like tea.' correct it please
'He doesn't like tea.' With he/she/it we use 'does not' (doesn't), not 'don't'.
'ma bhai le khana khayo' thik chha?
ali milena. 'ma' ra 'bhai le' duitai karta jasta bhaye. bhannu khojeko 'mero bhai le khana khayo' ho hola. ki 'maile khana khaye' bhanne ho bhane tyo pani thik.
ma ek vakya dinchhu, negative banaidinus: 'u ghar ma chha'
'u ghar ma chhaina.'
aba tyahi lai past tense ma lekhnus, negative nai rakhera
'u ghar ma thiyena.' 'chha' ko past 'thiyo' ho, ani negative 'thiyena'.
ani future?
'u ghar ma hune chhaina.' bolchal ma 'u ghar ma hudaina hola' pani bhaninchha.
'timi kaam gara' lai tapai form ma bhana
'tapai kaam garnus.'
ani yo sabai bhanda aadar garne form ma?
'hajur kaam garibaksiyos.' tara yo dherai aupacharik ho, ghar ma thula manchhe lai prayah 'garnus' nai bhaninchha.
what's the plural of 'person'?
The usual plural is 'people'. 'persons' exists too, but mostly in legal or formal writing.
and the plural of people?
'peoples' is used only when you mean different nations or ethnic groups, like 'the peoples of Asia'. For a crowd of humans, 'people' is already plural.
ma 'I goed home' lekhchhu, galti ho?
ho, 'goed' galti ho. 'go' ko past 'went' ho: 'I went home.'
ani 'I have went home' ta thik hola ni?
tyo pani thik bhayena. 'have' pachhi past participle chahinchha, jun 'gone' ho: 'I have gone home.' go - went - gone yaad garnus.
nepali ma 'kitab' ko plural?
'kitabharu'.
'mero kitabharu table ma chha' thik chha?
plural karta bhaye pachhi kriya pani plural hunu ramro: 'mero kitabharu table ma chhan.' bolchal ma 'chha' pani sunchha, tara lekhda 'chhan' thik.
'ma kaam garchhu' lai future ma bhannus
'ma kaam garnechhu.' bolchal ma 'ma kaam garchhu' (bholi bhanera) ki 'ma kaam garula' pani bhaninchha.
ani tyasko negative?
'ma kaam gardina' bhaye pugchha, bholi jodera: 'ma bholi kaam gardina.' 'garnechhaina' lekhai ma kahilekahi aauchha, tara bolchal ma kam.
english sentence check gardinu: 'There is many books in my bag.'
'many books' plural bhayeko le 'is' haina 'are' chahinchha: 'There are many books in my bag.'
ani 'There are a book' bhane?
ek ota matra bhaye 'is' chahinchha: 'There is a book in my bag.' a/an sanga sadhai singular.
dai lai 'aija' bhannu thik?
'aija' ta-form ho, dherai najik ko sano bhai-bahini lai bhaninchha. dai lai 'aau' (timi) ki 'aaunus' (tapai) bhannu ramro.
mero dai ra ma ekdam close chhau, umer ma 2 barsa matra farak
tyaso bhaye 'aau' ekdam thik chha, dherai dajubhai le timi nai bhanchhan. 'aija' bhane pani tapai haru bich chalchha hola, tara arulai sunda alik anaadar lagna sakchha.
